column1: # mtgish cross-check ledger, T2, whole corpus: every live disagreement and
# normalizer gap, triaged. TestMtgishLedger holds the live diff equal to the
# four tier files in both directions. Columns hold summary tokens only, never
# card text. Rebuild with `go run ./cmd/mtgishxc -all -write-ledger` (keeps triage).

#   | pending (not yet triaged; at most maxPendingRows, which only shrinks)
